expertise.title: How I work
expertise.subtitle: Maintainable code, decisions that can be explained, and teams that keep moving.

oop.title: OOP and SOLID principles
oop.body: Responsibility-driven design, dependency inversion and clear boundaries between domain and infrastructure so code is easy to test and change.

nest.title: Node.js and NestJS
nest.body: Modular REST and GraphQL APIs with dependency injection, validation, authentication (JWT/OAuth2) and automated tests.

rag.title: Generative AI and RAG
rag.body: Embedding pipelines and semantic search over vector databases, with guardrails, evaluations and observability to take them to production.

business.title: Negotiating with the business
business.body: I turn requirements into scope, risks and measurable trade-offs, and agree on priorities and realistic dates before writing code.

leadership.title: Technical leadership
leadership.body: I guide architecture decisions, give constructive code reviews and leave documentation and pipelines the team can maintain.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.subtitle: Got a project in mind? Tell me about it.
